question: In a certain code language, L is written as 15 and T is written as 7. How will LATER be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

L is written as 15

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b06f02ce057da5b871b7ad468de49cb20323bd5a194ff562aec9bb233140373d.png] 

And,

T is written as 7

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e763e749dcba2199d414c112c04c9ae54dde216964758e3549f3cbfda14626b.png] 

Similarly,

LATER will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1abb14b2dec33bae7d6385199a885d69c3422e0d8c90bcc278dddd80681a944.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
